parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: $\mathbf{a}$ and $\mathbf{b}$ are drawn from the origin. Drag the ends of the orange arrow so it shows $\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b}$.

objects.label: a + b
objects.feedback: Add the components: $\begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix} + \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ -3 \end{pmatrix}$. The arrow can start anywhere.

solution.content: $\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b} = \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ -2 \end{pmatrix}$: 3 right and 2 down, from any starting point.

objects.label: M
objects.feedback: The midpoint is the average of the coordinates: $\left(\frac{x_A + x_B}{2}, \frac{y_A + y_B}{2}\right)$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Find $|\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b}|$, giving your answer as an exact value.

m.feedback: Use Pythagoras on the components of $\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b}$, and leave the answer as a surd.
